ios.desc:
BETTER.FTP measures Functional Threshold Power using any FTMS-compatible smart trainer. No subscription, no account, no analytics.
Pair your trainer over Bluetooth, select a protocol, and start the test. The app controls the trainer in ERG mode and guides you through warmup, test, and cooldown. FTP is calculated automatically when the test completes.
PROTOCOLS
• Ramp Test (~20 minutes)
  10-minute warmup at 100 W. Power then increases by 20 W every minute until the rider can no longer maintain cadence. FTP is calculated as 75% of the best one-minute average power.
• 20-Minute Test (~45 minutes)
  15-minute warmup at 100 W. Followed by a sustained 20-minute maximum effort. FTP is calculated as 95% of the 20-minute average power. Based on the standard Coggan protocol.
FEATURES
• FTMS smart-trainer support (direct-drive and wheel-on)
• Optional Bluetooth heart-rate monitor
• Live display: power, target, heart rate, cadence, stage progress
• Automatic FTP calculation

• FIT file export for Strava, TrainingPeaks, intervals.icu, and other platforms

PRIVACY
All data is stored on the device. No account is required. The app contains no analytics or third-party tracking SDKs.

REQUIREMENTS
A Bluetooth FTMS-compatible smart trainer and iOS 13 or later.

Open source: github.com/niecore/betterftp.

quotes.text:
I built a free iOS app so cyclists can stop paying $20/mo just to retest their FTP. The ramp test itself is a 25-minute Bluetooth interaction with a known protocol. It shouldn't require rent. This app is opensource, free, no ads, no tracking nor third party integrations because I just wanted to have a fun side project and have no interest in monetization.

If you are a cyclist, I would kindly ask for feedback on the app especially on the ftp test protocol instructions, trainer-model compatibility, and bug reports

App store link: https://apps.apple.com/de/app/better-ftp/id6766080601

GitHub (opensource project): https://github.com/niecore/betterftp

Demo gif: https://betterftp.cc/promo.gif
